data.hook: RBI draft: a *trusted person* could approve your big transfers
data.hook_b: RBI draft: a *trusted person* could approve your big transfers
data.tldr: RBI's draft rules let customers name a trusted person to approve large transfers and add an account-wide 'stop' switch to block outgoing payments.

beats.what: Under the draft, any transfer above a threshold alerts the trusted person, who has one hour to approve or reject; unapproved ones are cancelled.
beats.why: RBI wants to curb digital payment fraud and give customers more control over channels and limits.
beats.care: A stop switch via branch, ATM, app, net banking or IVR would block outgoing payments, new mandates and new UPI registrations.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new

cards.q: Would you name a trusted person to approve big transfers?

facts.t: New accounts would get a bank-set limit for the first *24 hours* after activation.

data.watch: These are draft directions; RBI will finalise them after feedback. An earlier one-hour delay on all transfers was dropped.

sources.title: RBI proposes trusted approver, stop switch to curb digital fraud

data.fact: RBI proposes a *one-hour* trusted-person approval for large bank transfers

data.hook: *Singur* dam, a Hyderabad water source, drops below 2 TMC ft
data.hook_b: *Singur* dam, a Hyderabad water source, drops below 2 TMC ft
data.tldr: Singur reservoir, which supplies drinking water to Hyderabad, erstwhile Medak and Nizamabad, has fallen below 2 TMC ft for the first time in six years.

beats.why: Poor rain in the Manjeera catchment, and storage capped at 16 TMC ft last year on dam safety panel advice for repairs.

effects.label: About a fortnight of supply left

cards.body: HMWSSB will stop drawing from Singur at 0.8 TMC ft, the dead storage level, and switch to other sources.

cards.q: Has your area's water supply changed in the last month?

qs: Which other reservoirs will Hyderabad lean on if Singur stops?
